differences.text: Digits and unit letters are localised with Intl.NumberFormat (unit style, narrow) for the element's language; English output is identical to upstream (34s, 2m 08s, 1h 02m, 2:08, 1:02:33). Upstream is English only.

Arbitrary props on the <time> (id, aria-live, handlers) go on the host instead: an aria-live on the host makes the readout a live region, and events from the <time> bubble to the host. The <time> is part="time" and timeElement.
